breaking_changes.BC_description: Excess command-arguments now cause an error by default. The 'allowExcessArguments' setting is now 'false' by default, resulting in errors if a user specifies more command-arguments than are expected.

Throws during Option construction for unsupported option flags, such as multiple characters after single '-' (e.g., '-ab' is now disallowed if not following supported usage). This change results in an error being thrown instead of previous (undefined) behavior.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Full and precise list of unsupported option flag patterns that now throw an error must be specified (e.g., behavior for concatenated flags, complex patterns, or unusual cases). Also, clarify if there are exceptions or legacy behaviors permitted.

breaking_changes.BC_description: Multiple calls to '.parse()' will throw an error if 'storeOptionsAsProperties: true'. Previously, this behavior may have been allowed or undefined.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Avoid multiple calls to '.parse()' when 'storeOptionsAsProperties' is set to true. If necessary, consider refactoring code to only parse once, or set 'storeOptionsAsProperties' to false if multiple parses are required and supported.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: It must be clarified what the expected and supported behavior is when 'storeOptionsAsProperties' is false and '.parse()' is called multiple times, as well as all scenarios in which this error is triggered.

breaking_changes.BC_description: Help.wrap() has been refactored and removed; use 'formatItem()' and 'boxWrap()' instead. Any direct usage of 'Help.wrap()' will result in errors.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Replace any usage of 'Help.wrap()' with 'formatItem()' and/or 'boxWrap()', as appropriate. You need to refactor help formatting logic to use the new methods. Code-specific adaptation examples are not provided in the changelog and are required for precise migration.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Concrete code examples for migrating from 'Help.wrap()' to 'formatItem()' and/or 'boxWrap()' are needed, including explanation of parameter mappings and behavioral differences.
